!!Info on Chemistry Class 04!!

So, to those who want to know what will happen after this one is finished.
Originally Mum planed to, after finishing this one, release an new version of Pokiemen-Futa-League. But when she announced this, there were some idiots on twitter who didn't liked this and wanted Chemistry Class back as fast as possible.
Mum than told that she had the feeling her audience didn't give her the freedom to work on what she wanted and, under the given pressure said after House Party she would return to CC 4, wich has it's full plot already done.
Than some of her "nicer" followers intervened saying "You are the artist, we the viewers, it's up to you!"

She agreed upon this, but what exactly we can know expect:
- instant "Chemistry Class 4"
- Redo of "Pokiemen-Futa-League"

That didn't come through clear. So we have to wait, what will happen after House Party.
But when Pokiemen-Futa-League, we will have to wait till the end of the year for Chemistry Class 04 to resume.
